topics.title: System orientation
questions: What are the major products, services, repositories and data flows?
Which boundaries and dependencies must a successor understand first?
What is documented implementation, and what is actually known to be deployed?

topics.title: Consent and identity
questions: Why does consent matter here, according to recorded decisions?
Where and how is consent enforced?
Which identifiers, users, messages and integrations depend on it?
What breaks if consent behavior changes, and how would a migration be verified?

topics.title: Deployment and Ansible
questions: Why do deployments have these steps and constraints?
How do Ansible, CI/CD, environments, approvals and rollout interact?
How should a successor deploy, verify and roll back?
Which historical incidents or decisions explain the current hoops?

topics.title: CloudWatch and structured logging
questions: Why are CloudWatch resources and log streams organized this way?
What structured fields and correlation contracts do applications rely on?
Which dashboards, alerts, retention rules and consumers depend on that structure?
How can logging changes be validated and operational failures investigated?

topics.title: Usertags and change impact
questions: What are usertags and what do they mean in this system?
Which writers, readers, schemas, APIs and integrations use them?
If usertags are replaced, which explicitly evidenced consumers or contracts break?
What migration, compatibility and validation steps are actually documented?

topics.title: Iterable integration
questions: How and why does this system use Iterable?
Which identifiers, synchronization jobs, fields and events are contractual?
How do consent, segmentation and usertags interact with it?
What failure modes, recovery procedures and migration risks are recorded?

topics.title: Data contracts and dependencies
questions: Which data and event contracts cross service boundaries?
Who produces and consumes them, and why were they chosen?
How are compatibility, schema changes and recovery handled?
Which dependencies and unknown consumers must be checked before changing a contract?

topics.title: Decisions, incidents and inherited constraints
questions: Which recorded decisions and incidents explain current constraints?
What changed over time, and which approaches were proposed, superseded or abandoned?
Which lessons remain operationally relevant, and what is unresolved or contradictory?
